family.description: This family represents an uncharacterised domain found in bacterial proteins from the Bacteroidota phylum, particularly in members of Flavobacteriaceae and Sphingobacteriaceae. The domain typically spans approximately 90-100 residues and is positioned between the TMEM260-like domain ([pfam:PF11028]) and the TMEM260_2 domain ([pfam:PF28495]) in the protein architecture. These proteins appear to be glycosyltransferases or related membrane proteins. The function of this domain remains to be determined.
